name: eBay

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate - 2 rounds of code screening then a system design and behavioral round, though loop composition varies noticeably by report
rounds: 2 rounds of code screening (LeetCode-medium style, sometimes practical Spring Boot / backend implementation tasks with follow-ups on scalability and error handling)
Behavioral interview with the hiring manager
extraTopics: Practical backend implementation (e.g. building a small Spring Boot e-commerce service), not just abstract algorithms
Follow-up questions on scalability and design decisions after a working implementation
Software Engineer.notes: One report describes a 5-round loop (recruiter call, manager call, then 3 technical rounds) with situational rather than coding questions in the manager round - composition is not fixed.

sources.title: Glassdoor: eBay Software Engineer interview reports
used: multiple independent reports: Spring Boot practical round, 4-stage loop, and a 5-round loop with situational manager questions

rolesNotes: Only one source page was reviewed (several independent candidate reports on it, which is why the loop composition looks inconsistent - it may genuinely vary by team). Level naming beyond "Software Engineer" is not confirmed by any source reviewed.
